bullets: • Name the selector and property being changed explicitly.
• State exact before and after values with units.
• Verify only the stylesheet; reject out-of-scope changes.
• Assert sibling properties in the selector remain unchanged.
• Write AC as testable facts, not implementation steps.
• Ground assertions in observable computed CSS values.
• Use consistent units across all numeric comparisons.
• Exclude build steps, external tools, and file dependencies.
